mentions.name: Engram
mentions.description: A cognitive memory system for AI agents that replaces vector databases and semantic search with cognitive science models (ACT-R activation decay, Hebbian learning, forgetting curves) to decide what to remember and what to forget. Version 2 adds multi-agent shared memory.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on Engram, a cognitive memory system for AI agents. Instead of vector DB + semantic search, it uses models from cognitive science (ACT-R activation decay, Hebbian learning, forgetting curves) to decide what to remember and what to forget. Been running it in production for a month, 230K+ recalls. Just shipped v2 with multi-agent shared memory.
